s: Processes, file systems, permissions, shell scripting
d: Most backend servers run Linux. Understanding the OS — processes, memory, file systems, permissions, and how the kernel manages resources — is essential for deploying, debugging, and optimizing server applications.

p: Linux is the foundation of modern backend infrastructure. It provides process isolation, file system management, and networking capabilities. Understanding permissions, processes, and I/O streams is critical.
